newsitem.title: GERMANY: Vereinsbank upgrades rating on Hochtief, Holzmann.
newsitem.headline: Vereinsbank upgrades rating on Hochtief, Holzmann.

text.p: German investment house Vereinsbank Research said on Thursday it had issued upgrades on the shares of Germany's two largest construction groups -- Philipp Holzmann AG and Hochtief AG.
Vereinsbank said it placed Hochtief at "outperformer" from "market neutral" and Holzmann also at "outperformer" from "underperformer".
The bank said signs of a mutually-beneficial increase in cooperation bewteen the two construction groups were responsible for the upgrades.
